calibration_before_launch.method: time a tiny local dry-run on 3 representative scenarios and 6 existing parents plus 3 decoded parent genomes; adjust candidate_evaluations_per_treatment downward only if needed to maintain <=10 minute wall-clock, recording the adjustment before the screen starts

planned_budget.parent_envelope_reuse: reuse unified_utility_matrix_v2 anchor values for E6 where valid; do not rerun parents unless regression/fingerprint calibration requires it

target_runtime: local CPU, ideally <=10 minutes for first screen after implementation and calibration
